Trading Calendar and Trading Hours

Non-trading days at Frankfurter Wertpapierbörse are:

Holiday20262027
New Year's DayThursday Jan 01, 2026Friday Jan 01, 2027
Good FridayFriday Apr 03, 2026Friday Mar 26, 2027
Easter MondayMonday Apr 06, 2026Monday Mar 29, 2027
Labor DayFriday May 01, 2026Saturday May 01, 2027
Christmas EveThursday Dec 24, 2026Friday Dec 24, 2027
Christmas DayFriday Dec 25, 2026Saturday Dec 25, 2027
Boxing DaySaturday Dec 26, 2026Sunday Dec 26, 2027
New Year's EveThursday Dec 31, 2026Friday Dec 31, 2027

Please note that in the year 2026 regular stock exchange trading takes place on the following public holidays:

  • Ascension Day (14 May 2026)
  • Whit Monday (25 May 2026)
  • Corpus Christi (4 June 2026)

Trading on shares and Exchange traded products ends at 20:00 CET. Structured products are traded until 22:00 CET.

On December 30, 2026, deviating trading hours may apply. A circular will be published.
